name: PitchBench
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created using FluidSynth for music generation, music12 for scores, and royalty-free audio downloaded from FreeSound.
rai:dataCollectionType: The dataset comprises more than 20K audio fragments of various lengths, ranging from a few seconds to few minutes.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset contains synthetic music audio fragments of various instruments and waveforms. A small portion of the data was augmented with background noise from existing audio fragments.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training, validation, testing and fine-tuning.
